title: INTRO TO COMMUNICATION SYSTEMS
description: A basic course in communication theory, stressing modern digital communication systems. Nyquist sampling, PAM and PCM/DPCM systems, time division multipliexing, high frequency digital (ASK, OOK, FSK, PSK) systems, and AM and FM systems. An introduction to noise processes, detecting signals in the presence of noise, Shannons theorem on channel capacity, and elements of coding theory.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ELEN E3801 ) Corequisites: IEOR E3658
